task.title: Say who made this tree
task.shortdesc: Record who made the tree, so anyone who gets a copy knows who to ask.

stepresult.p: A new tree says Nobody is credited with this tree yet.

step.cmd: Choose , then under Add to the workspace, then .

info.p: The other boxes are for an address, a telephone number, an email or a website, a language and a copyright line. They are all optional.

step.cmd: Scroll to the bottom and choose .

stepresult.p: The list shows the name at once, marked (default). A line above it says what the tree states about its copyright.

step.cmd: Leave the list and open it again.

info.p: The list may not show the new name until you do.

stepresult.p: The name is in the list, marked (default).

result.p: Each name has buttons to and delete it. Use the name of your group, or your own name. Never put the details of a private person in a tree that you share.
